title: Variant Design 官网：三种进入方式
The Variant Design site: three ways in
summary: 同一个网站、同一组内容，分别把理解、试用和安装放在最前面。
One site and one set of content, leading with understanding, trying or installing.
brief: 理解 Variant Design，比较本站三版，安装并用于真实项目。
Understand Variant Design, compare the site's three versions, then install it in a real project.

optimizes: 先理解产品方法，再进入操作
Understand the product method before acting
tradeoff: 到达比较页面前需要多读一点说明
A little more reading before the comparison
bestFor: 第一次接触多方案设计的人

alt: A 方向首屏：先解释产品方法
Direction A first screen: explains the method first

optimizes: 直接检查真实产物，缩短到比较的路径
Inspect real output directly; shortest path to comparing
tradeoff: 首屏的品牌叙事更简短
A shorter brand story in the first screen
bestFor: 希望先试用，再判断是否安装的人
People who want to try it before deciding to install

alt: B 方向首屏：直接展示三种取舍
Direction B first screen: shows the three tradeoffs directly

optimizes: 快速安装并进入自己的项目
Install quickly and move into your own project
tradeoff: 对尚未理解技能的人解释较少
Less explanation for people new to the skill
bestFor: 已熟悉工作方式的开发者
Developers who already know the workflow

alt: C 方向首屏：安装命令放在最前
Direction C first screen: install command up front

reason: 当前任务是让人真实体验比较与迭代。B 首屏展示本站三种取舍，并把比较作为主要操作；这是产品判断，尚无转化数据。

The task is to let people actually try comparing and iterating. B shows this site's three tradeoffs in the first screen and makes comparison the main action. This is a product judgment; there is no conversion data yet.
